description: Error details have one wire shape (PROTOCOL_SPEC 8.1, decision D-149). A SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR carries `details.errors`, a list of items with exactly the keys `path`, `keyword` and `message`: `path` is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the validated instance (`/count`, `/tags/1`, and `""` for the root), `keyword` is the JSON Schema keyword that failed at that location. Measured before D-149 no two SDKs agreed and no SDK was self-consistent: apcore-python emitted `{field, code, message}` with a dotted path on the executor path and `{path, message, constraint, expected, actual}` with root `/` from its validator; apcore-typescript emitted a numeric TypeBox error type as `constraint` and root `/`; apcore-rust emitted `{field, message}` on the executor path and a dotted, bracketed path from its validator. `details` keys are snake_case in every serialized error.

driver_contract.path: Register the module of `module_contract` with a real Executor and call it — or the module named by `input.call_module_id` when present — with `input.inputs` through the public call path. Catch the error and serialize it with the SDK's canonical error serializer (Python to_dict, TypeScript toJSON, Rust serde). Assert on the serialized form.
driver_contract.errors_items: `expected.errors` lists the items `details.errors` MUST contain, compared as whole objects on `path` and `keyword` (order not significant). Every item of `details.errors` — listed or not — MUST have exactly the keys `path`, `keyword` and `message`, with `message` a non-empty string. `expected.error_count` is the exact length of the list when present.
driver_contract.detail_keys: `expected.detail_keys_present` / `expected.detail_keys_absent` name keys of the serialized `details` object.

test_cases.description: `required` is a keyword of the object, so the failure is located at the object that lacks the property — the root, whose pointer is the empty string, not `/`.
Fails a dotted (`tags.1`) or bracketed (`tags[1]`) path.
`keyword` is the JSON Schema keyword, not a validator-library error type.
A framework error raised with structured details serializes every `details` key in snake_case.
